introduction: The following special conditions apply specifically to this project and supplement the standard terms.

terms.title: No Measured Building Survey Undertaken By Noble Architecture
terms.content: No measured building survey, laser scan survey or site dimensional survey is included within Noble Architecture's appointment for this project, and no site visit is included. It was agreed during the telephone consultation on 7ᵗʰ September 2026 that the Client will carry out his own survey of the property and provide the resulting measurement information to Noble Architecture.

terms.title: Client Supplied Measurement Information
terms.content: The Client will provide photographs of the areas identified by Noble Architecture, with the dimensions marked over them. Noble Architecture will specify which areas and which dimensions are required. All drawings, models and documents produced by Noble Architecture will be prepared entirely from that Client supplied information.

terms.title: Limitation Of Liability For Dimensional Accuracy
terms.content: Noble Architecture is not able to verify, and gives no warranty as to, the accuracy of measurement information that it has not itself taken. The accuracy of all drawings, models and documents follows directly from the accuracy of the information supplied by the Client. Noble Architecture accepts no liability whatsoever for any error, omission, abortive work, remedial work, redesign or additional cost arising from inaccurate, incomplete or misinterpreted measurement information provided by the Client, including where such an error is only identified after submission of the application or during construction.

terms.title: Rationale For Omitting A Measured Survey
terms.content: This approach has been adopted deliberately and in the Client's commercial interest. A measured building survey or laser scan survey would add an additional site visit and travel, and would then add a significant period of data registration and processing before design work could begin at all. On a project of this scale and complexity that cost and lead time is not proportionate to the benefit obtained. The Client works within the construction industry and is experienced in taking and recording site dimensions. Where a project involves a full planning application or a Building Regulations technical package, Noble Architecture would ordinarily recommend that a measured survey be undertaken.

terms.title: Verification By Third Parties Before Construction
terms.content: Nothing issued by Noble Architecture constitutes a measured building survey. Any contractor, structural engineer, fabricator or specialist working from Noble Architecture's drawings must undertake their own site survey and verify all critical dimensions before ordering, fabrication, setting out or construction. Any party proceeding without independent site verification does so entirely at their own risk.
